# telnyx_email_domain_health (Data Source)

The health of an email domain, whether it can send and receive email, and the verification status of each DNS record.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "telnyx_email_domain_health" "mail" {
  id = telnyx_email_domain.mail.id
}

output "mail_can_send" {
  value = data.telnyx_email_domain_health.mail.usable_for_sending
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the email domain

### Read-Only

- `checked_at` (String) Timestamp of the last health check
- `record_type` (String) Record type discriminator
- `status` (String) Current domain status
- `usable_for_inbound` (Boolean) Whether the domain is usable for receiving inbound email
- `usable_for_sending` (Boolean) Whether the domain is usable for sending email
- `verification` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verification))

<a id="nestedatt--verification"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verification`

Read-Only:

- `dkim` (String)
- `dmarc` (String)
- `mx` (String)
- `ownership` (String)
- `spf` (String)
